10645233.note: Lysis centrifugation vs pour plate vs broth for melioidosis: median TTP 39.3 vs 45.5 vs 61.8 h (P<0.001); inverse correlation with quantitative load.

10325369.note: BACTEC 9240 7-day incubation: TTD distribution for bacteria/yeasts — 4 days sufficient for bacteria, 6 days for yeasts.

9620384.note: Multicenter BACTEC 9050 vs 9240: TTD compared; anaerobes recovered earlier with 9240 (35.0 vs 61.4 h, P<0.01).

9508291.note: BACTEC Plus/F vs BacT/Alert FAN aerobic+anaerobic: TTD compared; Gram-pos faster on BACTEC, Enterobacteriaceae faster on BacT/Alert.

9163464.note: BACTEC 9240 Plus Aerobic/F resin vs Isolator: median TTD favors BACTEC for all pathogens combined (P<0.05); per-species TTD reported.

9163448.note: BACTEC 9240 Peds Plus vs Isolator 1.5 for B. melitensis: TTD comparison; 36% of paired-positive cultures positive ≥1 day earlier by BACTEC (P=0.045).

9155676.note: Automated system vs Septichek for CAPD peritonitis: time to detection more rapid with AS (P<0.002); borderline (peritoneal fluid, not blood) but TTD measured.

9114401.note: BacT/Alert FAN aerobic vs ESP 80A pediatric BCs: median TTD 13.6 vs 15.7 h (P<0.001).
